records.name: Children's Medicaid (STAR)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free health coverage for children. It pays for checkups, dentist visits, medicine, shots, hospital care, vision, hearing, mental health care and rides to the doctor.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children 18 or younger (some children with disabilities up to age 20) who live in Texas, are U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens, and whose family income is under the limit (for example, $3,564 a month for a family of 4).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1. If your income is too high for Medicaid, you are checked for CHIP automatically.
records.notes: Monthly income limits on source: 1=$1,735; 2=$2,345; 3=$2,954; 4=$3,564; 5=$4,173; 6=$4,783; 7=$5,393; 8=$6,002; +$610 each additional person. HHS page points to 2-1-1 Texas for help.
records.description_es: Seguro médico gratis para niños. Paga chequeos, visitas al dentista, medicinas, vacunas, atención en el hospital, vista, oído, salud mental y transporte al doctor.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños de 18 años o menos (algunos niños con discapacidades hasta los 20 años) que viven en Texas, son ciudadanos de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican, y cuya familia gana menos del límite (por ejemplo, $3,564 al mes para una familia de 4).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1. Si su ingreso es muy alto para Medicaid, revisan automáticamente si califica para CHIP.

records.name: Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Low-cost health coverage for children whose families earn too much for Medicaid. It covers checkups, medicine, shots, hospital care, dental, vision and mental health care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children 18 or younger who live in Texas and are U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens, with family income under the CHIP limit (for example, $5,386 a month for a family of 4).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com. For help choosing a plan, call the enrollment broker helpline.
records.cost: Enrollment fee of $50 or less per family per year; small copays
records.notes: Monthly income limits: 1=$2,622; 2=$3,543; 3=$4,464; 4=$5,386; 5=$6,307; 6=$7,228; 7=$8,149; +$922 each. Enrollment fee $50 or less per family per year; copays $3-$5 or $20-$35 depending on income.
records.description_es: Seguro médico de bajo costo para niños cuyas familias ganan demasiado para Medicaid. Cubre chequeos, medicinas, vacunas, hospital, dentista, vista y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños de 18 años o menos que viven en Texas y son ciudadanos de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican, con ingreso familiar menor al límite de CHIP (por ejemplo, $5,386 al mes para una familia de 4).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com. Si necesita ayuda para escoger un plan, llame a la línea de ayuda de inscripción.

records.name: Medicaid for Pregnant Women
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free health care during pregnancy, including prenatal visits, prenatal vitamins, labor and delivery, and care after the baby is born. Coverage lasts up to 12 months after birth.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant women who live in Texas, are U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens, and meet income limits (for example, $3,571 a month for a family of 2).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1.
records.notes: Monthly gross income limits: 1=$2,634; 2=$3,571; 3=$4,508; 4=$5,445; 5=$6,383; +$938 each. Postpartum coverage up to 12 months.
records.description_es: Atención médica gratis durante el embarazo, incluyendo citas prenatales, vitaminas prenatales, el parto y cuidado después de que nace el bebé. La cobertura dura hasta 12 meses después del parto.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas que viven en Texas, son ciudadanas de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican, y cumplen con el límite de ingresos (por ejemplo, $3,571 al mes para una familia de 2).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1.

records.name: CHIP Perinatal
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Covers prenatal visits, prenatal vitamins, labor and delivery, and two checkups after the pregnancy ends for pregnant women who cannot get Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant women who live in Texas, do not qualify for Medicaid, have no other health insurance, and meet income limits (for example, $3,643 a month for a family of 2). Citizenship is not listed as a requirement on the source page.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1.
records.notes: Monthly gross income limits: 1=$2,687; 2=$3,643; 3=$4,599; 4=$5,555; 5=$6,512; +$957 each. Postpartum: two doctor visits within 60 days after pregnancy ends. Often an option for pregnant women who are not eligible for Medicaid due to immigration status.
records.description_es: Cubre citas prenatales, vitaminas prenatales, el parto y dos chequeos después del embarazo para mujeres embarazadas que no pueden recibir Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas que viven en Texas, no califican para Medicaid, no tienen otro seguro médico y cumplen con el límite de ingresos (por ejemplo, $3,643 al mes para una familia de 2). La página oficial no pide ciudadanía.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1.

records.name: Medicaid for Parents and Caretakers
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Medicaid health coverage for very low-income adults who care for a child who already gets Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Parents or related caretakers (like grandparents, aunts or siblings) of a child who has Medicaid and lives with them. Income limits are very low (for example, $230 a month for a one-parent family of 3).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1.
records.notes: Texas did not expand Medicaid; most adults without children or disabilities do not qualify. Child must be 17 or younger, or 18 and in school full time.
records.description_es: Seguro de Medicaid para adultos con ingresos muy bajos que cuidan a un niño que ya recibe Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres o familiares que cuidan al niño (como abuelos, tías o hermanos) de un niño que tiene Medicaid y vive con ellos. Los límites de ingreso son muy bajos (por ejemplo, $230 al mes para una familia de 3 con un solo padre).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1.

records.name: Healthy Texas Women (HTW) and HTW Plus
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free women's health and family planning services, like yearly exams, birth control, and disease screenings and treatment. Women who were pregnant in the last 12 months can get extra HTW Plus services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Women ages 15-44 (ages 15-17 need a parent or guardian to apply) who live in Texas, are U.S. citizens or qualified immigrants, have no health insurance, are not pregnant, and earn up to 204.2% of the federal poverty level (for example, $5,616 a month for a family of 4).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com. For help, call 2-1-1 (pick a language, then press 2) or 1-877-541-7905.
records.notes: Income limits effective March 1, 2026: 1=$2,716; 2=$3,682; 3=$4,649; 4=$5,616; 5=$6,582; 6=$7,549; 7=$8,515; +$967 each. Backup phone (877) 541-7905. Find a provider at healthytexaswomen.org/find-doctor.
records.description_es: Servicios gratis de salud para la mujer y planificación familiar, como examen anual, métodos anticonceptivos y pruebas y tratamiento de enfermedades. Las mujeres que estuvieron embarazadas en los últimos 12 meses pueden recibir servicios extra de HTW Plus.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres de 15 a 44 años (de 15 a 17 años necesitan que un padre o tutor aplique) que viven en Texas, son ciudadanas de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican, no tienen seguro médico, no están embarazadas y ganan hasta el 204.2% del nivel federal de pobreza (por ejemplo, $5,616 al mes para una familia de 4).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com. Si necesita ayuda, llame al 2-1-1 (escoja su idioma y luego oprima 2) o al 1-877-541-7905.

records.name: Family Planning Program (FPP)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free or low-cost family planning and reproductive health care for women and men, such as birth control and health screenings.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents age 64 or younger with income at or below 250% of the federal poverty level. Open to women and men.
records.how_to_apply: Find a Family Planning Program clinic at healthytexaswomen.org/find-doctor, or call 2-1-1 (pick a language, then press 2) or 1-877-541-7905. The clinic checks if you qualify.
records.notes: Income limits effective March 1, 2026: 1=$3,325; 2=$4,508; 3=$5,692; 4=$6,875; 5=$8,058 per month, up to $13,975/month for 10 people. Backup phone (877) 541-7905. Ask the clinic which papers to bring.
records.description_es: Planificación familiar y salud reproductiva gratis o de bajo costo para mujeres y hombres, como métodos anticonceptivos y pruebas de salud.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas, tienen 64 años o menos y ganan hasta el 250% del nivel federal de pobreza. Es para mujeres y hombres.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque una clínica del Programa de Planificación Familiar en healthytexaswomen.org/find-doctor, o llame al 2-1-1 (escoja su idioma y luego oprima 2) o al 1-877-541-7905. La clínica revisa si usted califica.

records.name: Breast and Cervical Cancer Services (BCCS)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free or low-cost breast and cervical cancer screening and follow-up tests, like mammograms, breast exams, pelvic exams and Pap tests.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Women 18 or older who live in Texas, have no health insurance or not enough insurance, and earn under 200% of the federal poverty level.
records.how_to_apply: Contact a BCCS clinic near you (search at healthytexaswomen.org/find-doctor) or call 2-1-1 and press 2.
records.description_es: Pruebas gratis o de bajo costo para detectar cáncer de seno y de cuello uterino, y pruebas de seguimiento, como mamografías, exámenes de seno, exámenes pélvicos y Papanicolaou.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres de 18 años o más que viven en Texas, no tienen seguro médico o su seguro no cubre lo suficiente, y ganan menos del 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a una clínica de BCCS cerca de usted (búsquela en healthytexaswomen.org/find-doctor) o llame al 2-1-1 y oprima 2.

records.name: Medicaid for Breast and Cervical Cancer (MBCC)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Full Medicaid coverage for women who need treatment for breast or cervical cancer, including cancer treatment, lab tests, hospital care and care coordination.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Women ages 18-64 in Texas who were diagnosed with breast or cervical cancer and need treatment, are U.S. citizens or eligible immigrants, have no health insurance, and earn at or below 200% of the federal poverty level.
records.how_to_apply: Contact a Breast and Cervical Cancer Services (BCCS) provider or call 2-1-1. The provider checks eligibility and sends the application to HHSC for you.
records.notes: Email mbccapps@hhs.texas.gov. For application status or Medicaid number, call 2-1-1. STAR+PLUS questions: HHS Ombudsman (866) 566-8989.
records.description_es: Cobertura completa de Medicaid para mujeres que necesitan tratamiento para cáncer de seno o de cuello uterino, incluyendo tratamiento del cáncer, análisis de laboratorio, hospital y coordinación de su atención.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres de 18 a 64 años en Texas con diagnóstico de cáncer de seno o de cuello uterino que necesitan tratamiento, son ciudadanas de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican, no tienen seguro médico y ganan hasta el 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con una clínica de Servicios para el Cáncer de Seno y de Cuello Uterino (BCCS) o llame al 2-1-1. La clínica revisa si califica y envía la solicitud a HHSC por usted.

records.name: Medicaid Buy-In for Adults
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Lets working adults with disabilities get Medicaid by paying a monthly fee based on income. Covers doctor visits, hospital care, medicine, mental health care and therapies.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texans with a disability who are working, with earned income under $3,325 a month and assets of $5,000 or less. People getting Social Security disability benefits meet the disability rule.
documents_needed: Application form H1200 (if applying by mail/fax)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com, call 2-1-1, visit a local HHSC benefits office, or mail/fax form H1200.
records.notes: Unearned income (money not from work) cannot be more than $994 a month. Monthly premium up to $500 depending on income. Retirement accounts and PASS funds do not count as assets. Cannot live full time in a state institution or nursing home.
records.description_es: Permite que adultos con discapacidades que trabajan reciban Medicaid pagando una cuota mensual según su ingreso. Cubre doctor, hospital, medicinas, salud mental y terapias.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Texas con una discapacidad que están trabajando, con ingreso de trabajo menor a $3,325 al mes y bienes de $5,000 o menos. Si recibe beneficios de discapacidad del Seguro Social, cumple con la regla de discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com, llame al 2-1-1, vaya a una oficina local de beneficios de HHSC, o envíe el formulario H1200 por correo o fax.

records.name: Medicaid Buy-In for Children (MBIC)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Lets families with a child who has a disability buy Medicaid coverage, even if they earn too much for regular Medicaid. Covers the same services as Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children 18 or younger with a disability who are U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens living in Texas, with family income under the limit (for example, $8,250 a month for a family of 4).
documents_needed: Application form H1200 (if applying by mail/fax)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com, call 2-1-1, or apply by mail, fax or in person at an HHSC benefits office.
records.notes: Monthly income limits: 1=$3,990; 2=$5,410; 3=$6,830; 4=$8,250; +$1,420 each. Premium up to $230/month (up to $70 with employer insurance plus HIPP).
records.description_es: Permite que familias con un niño con discapacidad compren cobertura de Medicaid, aunque ganen demasiado para Medicaid regular. Cubre los mismos servicios que Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños de 18 años o menos con una discapacidad, que son ciudadanos de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican y viven en Texas, con ingreso familiar menor al límite (por ejemplo, $8,250 al mes para una familia de 4).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com, llame al 2-1-1, o aplique por correo, fax o en persona en una oficina de beneficios de HHSC.

records.name: Medicaid for the Elderly and People with Disabilities (MEPD)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Medicaid for seniors and people with disabilities. It covers doctor visits, medicine, hospital care, and long-term care like help at home or nursing home care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors and adults or children with disabilities who live in Texas and are U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens. You may qualify even if you have Medicare.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1. Your local Aging and Disability Resource Center can also help.
records.notes: Income and asset limits vary by program and were not listed on the source page. The rules keys 'senior' and 'disability' mean either group may qualify.
records.description_es: Medicaid para personas mayores y personas con discapacidades. Cubre doctor, medicinas, hospital y cuidado a largo plazo, como ayuda en casa o cuidado en un asilo de ancianos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas mayores y adultos o niños con discapacidades que viven en Texas y son ciudadanos de EE. UU. o inmigrantes que califican. Puede calificar aunque tenga Medicare.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1. Su Centro de Recursos para Personas Mayores y con Discapacidades (ADRC) local también le puede ayudar.

records.name: Health Insurance Premium Payment Program (HIPP)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Pays the cost of job-based health insurance when a family member has Medicaid and it saves the state money. You keep both your job insurance and Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families with at least one person on Medicaid who can get health insurance through a job. People in STAR Health or CHIP cannot take part.
documents_needed: Proof of health insurance payment (if already enrolled)
records.how_to_apply: Fill out Form 5020 and send it with your insurance papers. Call for help applying.
records.notes: Employer plan must cover at least 60% of costs for key services.
records.description_es: Paga el costo del seguro médico de su trabajo cuando alguien de la familia tiene Medicaid y eso le ahorra dinero al estado. Usted se queda con el seguro del trabajo y con Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias con por lo menos una persona con Medicaid que puede obtener seguro médico por medio de un trabajo. Las personas en STAR Health o CHIP no pueden participar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el Formulario 5020 y envíelo con los papeles de su seguro. Llame si necesita ayuda para aplicar.

records.name: Medicaid for Transitioning and Former Foster Care Youth
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Medicaid for young adults who were in Texas foster care. It covers doctor visits, medicine, hospital stays, glasses, dental care and rides to appointments.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Youth ages 18-20 who were in Texas foster care on their 18th birthday (income limits apply), or former foster youth ages 18-25 who had Medicaid when they aged out (no income limit).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com.
records.notes: Transitioning youth income limit: $5,493/month for 1 person, +$1,955 per extra household member. Phone 2-1-1 is the general HHS benefits line.
records.description_es: Medicaid para jóvenes adultos que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care) en Texas. Cubre doctor, medicinas, hospital, lentes, dentista y transporte a las citas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes de 18 a 20 años que estaban en cuidado de crianza en Texas el día que cumplieron 18 (hay límite de ingresos), o jóvenes de 18 a 25 años que tenían Medicaid cuando salieron del cuidado de crianza (sin límite de ingresos).
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com.

records.name: Texas Health Steps
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free medical checkups from birth and dental checkups starting at 6 months for children with Medicaid, plus help finding doctors and getting rides.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from birth through age 20 who have Medicaid.
records.how_to_apply: Call Texas Health Steps to find a doctor or dentist and schedule a checkup.
records.notes: 877-THSTEPS. Relay Texas: 7-1-1. Email thsteps@hhsc.state.tx.us.
records.description_es: Chequeos médicos gratis desde que nacen y chequeos dentales desde los 6 meses para niños con Medicaid, además de ayuda para encontrar doctores y transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde que nacen hasta los 20 años que tienen Medicaid.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Texas Health Steps para encontrar un doctor o dentista y hacer una cita para un chequeo.

records.name: Nonemergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free rides to doctor, dentist, hospital, drug store and other covered health care visits, by bus, taxi, van or other transit.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with Medicaid, Children with Special Health Care Needs, or Transportation for Indigent Cancer Patients who have no other way to get there.
documents_needed: Medicaid ID or Social Security number
records.how_to_apply: If you have a Medicaid health plan, call the transportation number for your plan. If not, call 877-MED-TRIP. Call at least 2 workdays before (5 days for out-of-county trips).
records.notes: 877-MED-TRIP line is for members without a health plan. Same-day rides may be approved for urgent doctor visits, hospital discharge or pharmacy trips.
records.description_es: Transporte gratis a citas con el doctor, dentista, hospital, farmacia y otras citas de salud cubiertas, en autobús, taxi, van u otro transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con Medicaid, con el programa para Niños con Necesidades Especiales de Salud, o con Transporte para Pacientes de Cáncer de Bajos Recursos, que no tienen otra forma de llegar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si tiene un plan de salud de Medicaid, llame al número de transporte de su plan. Si no, llame al 877-MED-TRIP (877-633-8747). Llame por lo menos 2 días hábiles antes (5 días si viaja fuera de su condado).

records.name: HHS Office of the Ombudsman (Medicaid/CHIP managed care help)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Helps Medicaid and CHIP members who have problems with their health plan or with getting services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas Medicaid and CHIP members.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Ombudsman if your health plan cannot solve your problem. For service coordination, first call the number on your health plan ID card.
records.notes: STAR Kids, STAR Health and STAR+PLUS members get a service coordinator automatically; STAR and CHIP members with special health care needs also qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con Medicaid y CHIP que tienen problemas con su plan de salud o para recibir servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con Medicaid o CHIP en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Oficina del Ombudsman si su plan de salud no puede resolver su problema. Para coordinar servicios, primero llame al número en su tarjeta del plan de salud.

records.name: County Indigent Health Care Program (CIHCP)
records.organization: Texas counties, overseen by Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Your county may pay for basic health care, like doctor visits, hospital care, lab tests, X-rays and shots, for very low-income residents who cannot get Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents with income at or below 21% of the federal poverty level, resources under $2,000, and who do not qualify for Medicaid. Counties or hospital districts may use more generous rules.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your county's indigent health care office. Call 2-1-1 or search 211texas.org to find it.
records.notes: Statewide minimum rules; each county runs its own program. Large hospital districts (e.g., in Harris, Dallas, Travis, Bexar, Tarrant) run their own financial assistance programs with different limits. Email CIHCP@hhs.texas.gov.
records.description_es: Su condado puede pagar atención médica básica, como doctor, hospital, análisis de laboratorio, rayos X y vacunas, para residentes con ingresos muy bajos que no pueden recibir Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas con ingreso igual o menor al 21% del nivel federal de pobreza, bienes de menos de $2,000, y que no califican para Medicaid. Algunos condados o distritos de hospitales tienen reglas más flexibles.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con la oficina de atención médica para personas de bajos recursos de su condado. Llame al 2-1-1 o busque en 211texas.org para encontrarla.

records.name: Primary Health Care Services Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Basic health care at contracted clinics, including checkups, treatment for common illness, shots, family planning, lab tests and X-rays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents with income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level who cannot get the same services from another program.
records.how_to_apply: Call 2-1-1 or search 211texas.org to find a clinic. You apply at the clinic with help from staff; sometimes you can get care the same day you apply.
records.notes: Email PrimaryHealthCare@hhs.texas.gov. Ask the clinic which papers to bring and if there is any cost.
records.description_es: Atención médica básica en clínicas del programa, incluyendo chequeos, tratamiento de enfermedades comunes, vacunas, planificación familiar, análisis de laboratorio y rayos X.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas con ingreso igual o menor al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza y que no pueden recibir los mismos servicios por otro programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 2-1-1 o busque en 211texas.org para encontrar una clínica. Usted aplica en la clínica con ayuda del personal; a veces puede recibir atención el mismo día que aplica.

records.name: Title V Maternal and Child Health Fee-for-Service Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Medical and dental care at contracted clinics for pregnant women and for children and teens, including prenatal care, well-child checkups, shots, and dental care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents with income at or below 185% of the federal poverty level who cannot get Medicaid or CHIP: pregnant women (up to 90 days after birth) and children and teens from birth to age 21.
records.how_to_apply: Call 2-1-1 or search 211texas.org to find a clinic, then call or visit the clinic. Staff check if you qualify and help you apply; sometimes you can get care the same day.
records.notes: Email titlevffs@hhs.texas.gov. Same-day services possible in some cases.
records.description_es: Atención médica y dental en clínicas del programa para mujeres embarazadas, niños y adolescentes, incluyendo cuidado prenatal, chequeos del niño sano, vacunas y dentista.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas con ingreso igual o menor al 185% del nivel federal de pobreza y que no pueden recibir Medicaid ni CHIP: mujeres embarazadas (hasta 90 días después del parto) y niños y adolescentes desde que nacen hasta los 21 años.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 2-1-1 o busque en 211texas.org para encontrar una clínica, y luego llame o vaya a la clínica. El personal revisa si califica y le ayuda a aplicar; a veces puede recibir atención el mismo día.

records.name: Children with Special Health Care Needs (CSHCN) Services Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Helps pay for medical, dental, vision and mental health care, special equipment and case management for children with serious long-term health problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texans age 20 or younger (any age with cystic fibrosis) with a physical medical condition lasting at least a year, and family income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level.
records.how_to_apply: Send the forms and proofs to your local public health office or the program. You must also apply for Medicaid and CHIP for your child.
records.notes: Program helpline 800-222-3986 (eligibility, applications, waiting list). Client line (877) 888-2350 for services and prior authorization. Email cshcn@hhs.texas.gov. Fax 512-206-3988. Mail: CSHCN Services Program, Mail Code 1938, P.O. Box 149030, Austin, TX 78714-9947. There may be a waiting list. Mental or behavioral conditions alone do not qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar atención médica, dental, de la vista y de salud mental, equipo especial y manejo de casos para niños con problemas de salud graves y de largo plazo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Texas de 20 años o menos (de cualquier edad si tienen fibrosis quística) con una condición médica física que dura por lo menos un año, y con ingreso familiar igual o menor al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Envíe los formularios y comprobantes a su oficina local de salud pública o al programa. También tiene que aplicar a Medicaid y CHIP para su hijo.

records.name: Kidney Health Care (KHC) Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Helps people with end-stage kidney disease pay for dialysis, access surgery, medicine, travel to treatment, and Medicare premiums.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents with end-stage renal disease on regular dialysis or with a kidney transplant, income under $60,000 a year, and no Medicaid coverage for these benefits.
records.how_to_apply: Ask the social worker at your dialysis center, hospital or VA facility to help you apply.
records.notes: Email khc@hhs.texas.gov. Application fax 512-206-3982. Mail: Kidney Health Care, Mail Code 1938, P.O. Box 149030, Austin, TX 78714-9947.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con enfermedad renal en etapa final a pagar diálisis, cirugía de acceso, medicinas, viajes al tratamiento y primas de Medicare.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas con enfermedad renal en etapa final, que reciben diálisis regular o tienen un trasplante de riñón, ganan menos de $60,000 al año y no tienen cobertura de Medicaid para estos beneficios.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida ayuda para aplicar al trabajador social de su centro de diálisis, hospital o centro del VA.

records.name: Epilepsy Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Outpatient care for epilepsy, including diagnosis, treatment and case management, at contracted clinics.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents with epilepsy (or suspected epilepsy) and income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level. People under 21 must not qualify for the CSHCN Services Program (or must be on its waiting list).
records.how_to_apply: Go to a contracted epilepsy clinic in your county with proof of income and Texas residency. Call 2-1-1 to find one. Services may start the same day.
records.notes: Email epilepsy@hhs.texas.gov.
records.description_es: Atención ambulatoria para la epilepsia, incluyendo diagnóstico, tratamiento y manejo de casos, en clínicas del programa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas con epilepsia (o posible epilepsia) y con ingreso igual o menor al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza. Los menores de 21 años no deben calificar para el programa CSHCN (o deben estar en su lista de espera).
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a una clínica de epilepsia del programa en su condado con comprobante de ingresos y de que vive en Texas. Llame al 2-1-1 para encontrar una. Los servicios pueden empezar el mismo día.

records.name: Hemophilia Assistance Program (HAP)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Helps pay for blood factor products or health insurance premiums for adults with hemophilia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents 18 or older with hemophilia, income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level, who cannot get Medicaid, CHIP or CSHCN services.
records.how_to_apply: Send the forms and proofs by fax (512-206-3982), mail or email.
records.notes: Email hemophilia@hhs.texas.gov. Mail: Hemophilia Assistance Program, Mail Code 1938, P.O. Box 149030, Austin, TX 78714-9947.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar productos de factor de coagulación o primas de seguro médico para adultos con hemofilia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 18 años o más que viven en Texas, tienen hemofilia, ganan hasta el 200% del nivel federal de pobreza y no pueden recibir Medicaid, CHIP ni servicios de CSHCN.
records.how_to_apply_es: Envíe los formularios y comprobantes por fax (512-206-3982), por correo o por correo electrónico.

records.name: Texas HIV Medication Program (THMP)
records.organization: Texas Department of State Health Services
records.description_en: Provides HIV medicines and help with insurance costs for HIV treatment for low-income Texans, through community pharmacies.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income Texans living with HIV who meet program rules.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the TakeChargeTexas portal, or call for help applying by phone.
records.notes: Email hivstd@dshs.texas.gov. Income limit not stated on source page.
records.description_es: Da medicinas para el VIH y ayuda con los costos del seguro para el tratamiento del VIH a personas de bajos ingresos en Texas, por medio de farmacias de la comunidad.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos en Texas que viven con VIH y cumplen con las reglas del programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en el portal TakeChargeTexas, o llame para recibir ayuda para aplicar por teléfono.

records.name: Texas Medicare Help Line (Health Information, Counseling and Advocacy Program)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free, unbiased counseling on Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medigap, Part D drug plans, and programs that help pay Medicare costs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with Medicare, people about to get Medicare, and their families and caregivers in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the free Texas Medicare help line to talk to a certified counselor.
records.notes: Texas's State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP). Can help apply for Extra Help and Medicare Savings Programs.
records.description_es: Consejería gratis e imparcial sobre Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medigap, planes de medicinas de la Parte D y programas que ayudan a pagar los costos de Medicare.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con Medicare, personas que pronto tendrán Medicare, y sus familias y cuidadores en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame gratis a la línea de ayuda de Medicare de Texas para hablar con un consejero certificado.

records.name: Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, QI, QDWI)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Helps people with Medicare pay premiums, and sometimes deductibles and copays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texans with Medicare and limited income. Monthly income limits for one person: QMB up to $1,330; SLMB $1,330.01 to $1,596; QI $1,596 to less than $1,796. QDWI is for working people with disabilities (up to $2,660 a month for one person).
records.how_to_apply: Call 800-252-9240 for free help, visit a local HHS benefits office, or apply at YourTexasBenefits.com.
records.notes: Couple limits: QMB $1,804; SLMB $1,804.01-$2,164; QI $2,164 to less than $2,435; QDWI $3,607 (QDWI limits effective March 1, 2026). Asset limits also apply. People under 65 with Medicare because of a disability can also qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con Medicare a pagar sus primas y, a veces, deducibles y copagos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Texas con Medicare e ingresos limitados. Límites de ingreso mensual para una persona: QMB hasta $1,330; SLMB de $1,330.01 a $1,596; QI de $1,596 a menos de $1,796. QDWI es para personas con discapacidades que trabajan (hasta $2,660 al mes para una persona).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 800-252-9240 para recibir ayuda gratis, vaya a una oficina local de beneficios de HHS, o aplique en YourTexasBenefits.com.

records.name: Extra Help with Medicare Drug Costs (Low-Income Subsidy)
records.organization: Social Security Administration / Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
records.description_en: Helps people with Medicare pay for Part D prescription drug premiums, deductibles and copays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with Medicare and limited income and resources. 2026 limits: $23,940 income and $18,090 resources for one person; $32,460 income and $36,100 resources for a married couple. People on Medicaid, SSI or a Medicare Savings Program qualify automatically.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at SSA.gov, or get free help from the Texas Medicare help line (800-252-9240).
records.notes: Phone is 1-800-MEDICARE (TTY 1-877-486-2048). You can apply for Extra Help and Medicare Savings Programs at the same time.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con Medicare a pagar las primas, deducibles y copagos de los medicamentos de la Parte D.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. Límites de 2026: $23,940 de ingreso y $18,090 de recursos para una persona; $32,460 de ingreso y $36,100 de recursos para una pareja casada. Las personas con Medicaid, SSI o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare califican automáticamente.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en SSA.gov, o reciba ayuda gratis de la línea de ayuda de Medicare de Texas (800-252-9240).

records.name: Health Insurance Marketplace (HealthCare.gov) and Local Enrollment Help
records.organization: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
records.description_en: Texas uses HealthCare.gov to sell private health plans. Many people get tax credits that lower the monthly cost. Free trained helpers (navigators and assisters) can help you enroll.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Texas who need health insurance. Open Enrollment starts November 1.
records.how_to_apply: Apply at HealthCare.gov or call the Marketplace. Find free local help at localhelp.healthcare.gov.
records.cost: Monthly premium; financial help based on income
records.notes: Find navigators/assisters by ZIP code at https://localhelp.healthcare.gov.
records.description_es: Texas usa HealthCare.gov para vender planes de seguro médico privados. Mucha gente recibe créditos fiscales que bajan el costo mensual. Hay ayudantes capacitados gratis (navegadores y asistentes) que le ayudan a inscribirse.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Texas que necesitan seguro médico. La inscripción abierta empieza el 1 de noviembre.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en HealthCare.gov o llame al Mercado de Seguros. Encuentre ayuda local gratis en localhelp.healthcare.gov.

records.name: Community Health Center Finder
records.organization: Texas Association of Community Health Centers (TACHC)
records.description_en: Online search tool to find a community health center (FQHC) near you. Health centers give medical, dental and mental health care, often on a sliding fee scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas looking for a community health center, including people without insurance.
records.how_to_apply: Search for a health center at my.tachc.org/s/search-centers, then call the center to make an appointment.
records.cost: Free to search; clinics use sliding fee scales
records.notes: TACHC is a membership association; phone reaches TACHC's Austin office, not a clinic. HRSA's national finder: https://findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov/. The TACHC finder page had loading issues when checked.
records.description_es: Herramienta en línea para encontrar un centro de salud comunitario (FQHC) cerca de usted. Los centros de salud dan atención médica, dental y de salud mental, muchas veces con tarifas según su ingreso.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas que busca un centro de salud comunitario, incluso si no tiene seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque un centro de salud en my.tachc.org/s/search-centers y luego llame al centro para hacer una cita.

records.name: Find a Health Center
records.organization: Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA)
records.description_en: Federal online tool to find HRSA-funded community health centers near you by address or ZIP code.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone; health centers serve people with or without insurance.
records.how_to_apply: Enter your address or ZIP code at findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov and call the nearest center.
records.description_es: Herramienta federal en línea para encontrar centros de salud comunitarios cerca de usted por dirección o código postal.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona; los centros de salud atienden a personas con o sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Escriba su dirección o código postal en findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov y llame al centro más cercano.

records.name: Medicaid and CHIP Drug Store Finder
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Online tool to find drug stores that fill Medicaid and CHIP prescriptions, including stores that deliver.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Medicaid and CHIP members in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Use the drug store finder on the HHS website. For questions, call 1-800-335-8957, pick a language, then press 6.
records.notes: Try to use one drug store for all your prescriptions.
records.description_es: Herramienta en línea para encontrar farmacias que surten recetas de Medicaid y CHIP, incluyendo farmacias que entregan a domicilio.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con Medicaid o CHIP en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el buscador de farmacias en la página de HHS. Si tiene preguntas, llame al 1-800-335-8957, escoja su idioma y luego oprima 6.

records.name: Texas Local Public Health Departments Directory
records.organization: Texas Department of State Health Services
records.description_en: A list of local health departments and public health districts in Texas, with addresses and phone numbers. Many offer shots, TB and STD testing, and other public health services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Look up your local health department in the directory and call them.
records.notes: Services vary by health department; call first.
records.description_es: Una lista de los departamentos de salud locales y distritos de salud pública en Texas, con direcciones y teléfonos. Muchos ofrecen vacunas, pruebas de tuberculosis y de enfermedades de transmisión sexual, y otros servicios de salud pública.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque su departamento de salud local en la lista y llámeles.

records.name: Texas Vaccines for Children and Adult Safety Net Programs
records.organization: Texas Department of State Health Services
records.description_en: Free or low-cost vaccines for children and for adults without insurance, given at participating clinics and health departments.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texans who need vaccines regardless of ability to pay. Adult Safety Net: adults 19 or older with no health insurance (usually up to $25 per vaccine). Ask the clinic about rules for children's vaccines.
records.how_to_apply: Call the DSHS Immunization Section at 800-252-9152 or use the DSHS Find a Provider map to find a clinic. You can also call your local health department or 2-1-1.
records.cost: Free or low cost (adult vaccines usually up to $25 each)
records.notes: Adults who already have insurance cannot use the Adult Safety Net program. Details for children's vaccine eligibility were not on the pages checked; confirm with the clinic. ASN page: https://www.dshs.texas.gov/immunizations/what-we-do/programs/asn
records.description_es: Vacunas gratis o de bajo costo para niños y para adultos sin seguro médico, en clínicas y departamentos de salud participantes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Texas que necesitan vacunas, sin importar si pueden pagar. Programa para adultos (Adult Safety Net): adultos de 19 años o más sin seguro médico (normalmente hasta $25 por vacuna). Pregunte en la clínica sobre las reglas para las vacunas de niños.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Sección de Vacunas de DSHS al 800-252-9152 o use el mapa Find a Provider de DSHS para encontrar una clínica. También puede llamar a su departamento de salud local o al 2-1-1.

records.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
records.organization: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
records.description_en: Free, private support 24 hours a day for anyone in emotional distress, a mental health crisis, or with alcohol or drug concerns.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone, any time.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text 988, or chat at chat.988lifeline.org.
records.description_es: Apoyo gratis y confidencial las 24 horas para cualquier persona con angustia emocional, una crisis de salud mental, o problemas con el alcohol o las drogas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona, a cualquier hora.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un texto al 988, o chatee en chat.988lifeline.org.

records.name: Texas Tobacco Quitline (Yes Quit)
records.organization: Texas Department of State Health Services
records.description_en: Free coaching and a personal quit plan to help you stop smoking, vaping or using other tobacco. Adults can get free nicotine patches, gum or lozenges.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents ages 13 and older. Nicotine replacement is for adults 18 and older; a youth program serves ages 13-17.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-877-YES-QUIT (1-877-937-7848) or enroll online through yesquit.org.
records.notes: Online enrollment goes to texas.quitlogix.org. Interpreters available by phone for other languages.
records.description_es: Consejería gratis y un plan personal para ayudarle a dejar de fumar, vapear o usar otro tabaco. Los adultos pueden recibir parches, chicles o pastillas de nicotina gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas de 13 años o más. Los productos de nicotina son para adultos de 18 años o más; hay un programa para jóvenes de 13 a 17 años.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-877-YES-QUIT (1-877-937-7848) o inscríbase en línea por medio de yesquit.org.

records.name: 2-1-1 Texas
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free help line and website that connects you to local services for health care, food, housing and more. It is also the phone line for Medicaid, CHIP and other state benefits questions.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Dial 2-1-1 (or 877-541-7905), chat online, or search 211texas.org.
records.notes: Alternate number (877) 541-7905. Live chat in English and Spanish.
records.description_es: Línea de ayuda y sitio web gratis que le conecta con servicios locales de salud, comida, vivienda y más. También es la línea para preguntas sobre Medicaid, CHIP y otros beneficios del estado.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Marque 2-1-1 (o 877-541-7905), chatee en línea o busque en 211texas.org.

records.name: Aging and Disability Resource Centers (ADRC) - Statewide Line
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: One place to get information and help finding long-term care, like personal care, nursing care and help at home, for older adults and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Older adults, people with disabilities, and their caregivers in all 254 Texas counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call 855-YES-ADRC to be connected to your local ADRC.
records.notes: 855-YES-ADRC routes to the local ADRC.
records.description_es: Un solo lugar para recibir información y ayuda para encontrar cuidado a largo plazo, como cuidado personal, cuidado de enfermería y ayuda en casa, para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos mayores, personas con discapacidades y sus cuidadores en los 254 condados de Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 855-YES-ADRC (855-937-2372) para que le conecten con su ADRC local.
